title: Halloween at Hampton Court Palace
summary: Follow the autumn trail through the Wilderness, then explore the palace’s ghostly displays and storytelling. Some indoor scenes have loud noises and jump scares.
ages: Families; check the organiser’s scare guidance

title: Explore the Magic Garden
summary: Climb the towers, find the grotto and meet the dragon in the palace’s adventure playground.
when: Seasonal opening; check your visit date
cost: Included in palace admission; no garden-only ticket

title: Climb, balance and play at Bushy Park
location: Near Diana Fountain · Hampton Court Gate, Bushy Park
summary: Try the timber climbing frame, balance trail, sandpit and swings, with a nearby kiosk and children’s toilets.
when: Daily; check closing times before setting off

title: Take on Kingston’s Heritage Hunt
location: Kingston Museum, town centre & All Saints Church · Kingston
summary: Make a family trail through the museum, the historic town centre and All Saints Church. Follow the Heritage Hunt link for the activity.
ages: A game for the whole family
cost: See the activity page for details

title: Explore Bushy Park’s woodland gardens
summary: Follow the garden paths among trees and waterways. Family idea: take turns spotting different leaf shapes on a gentle woodland walk.
when: Check garden gates and seasonal closing times
ages: Family walk; choose a route to suit your group

title: Find your way through the palace Maze
summary: Choose the next turning together and see who can lead the family to the centre of Hampton Court’s hedge maze.
when: Check palace opening days and Maze access
cost: See current ticket options on the official page

title: Dress up at Kingston Museum
summary: Try clothes and accessories from different eras in the Living History Corner. An easy indoor family activity for a rainy day.
when: During museum opening hours; check before visiting
